title: Western blot
summary: Transfer SDS-PAGE proteins to a membrane, probe with antibodies, detect by chemiluminescence.
hazardsMd: Methanol in transfer buffer is flammable + toxic. Mix and decant inside a fume hood. ECL substrate is light-sensitive — image promptly.
contentUndergrad:
## Decisions you'll make
Membrane: PVDF for repeat-imaging, nitrocellulose for sensitivity. Block: milk for most, BSA for phospho-protein primaries (milk has phosphoproteins).

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE
steps.instructionMd: Follow the SDS-PAGE protocol with your loading scheme. Don't stain the gel — proceed straight to transfer.
steps.verificationMd: Pre-stained ladder visibly separated. Dye front migrated to bottom but not run off.

steps.title: Transfer to membrane
steps.instructionMd: Wet transfer: assemble sandwich (sponge / paper / gel / membrane / paper / sponge), submerge in cold transfer buffer, transfer at 100 V / 60 min with ice pack. Or semi-dry: 25 V / 30 min.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Check ice pack midway; overheated transfer destroys protein.
steps.verificationMd: Pre-stained ladder visibly transferred to membrane. No air bubbles in the sandwich (rolled out beforehand).

steps.title: Block
steps.instructionMd: Submerge membrane in 5% milk in TBST for 1 hour at RT (or 4 °C overnight). Use a rocker.

steps.title: Probe with antibodies
steps.instructionMd: Primary antibody at validated dilution in blocking buffer, 4 °C overnight. Wash 3× 5 min in TBST. Secondary 1:5000 in blocking buffer, 1 hour RT. Wash 3× 10 min.
steps.verificationMd: Antibody covers membrane fully. Wash buffer drained between steps. No drying.

steps.title: Detect with ECL
steps.instructionMd: Mix ECL substrate per kit. Drain TBST off membrane, apply ECL evenly, incubate 1 min. Image immediately on gel doc / chemilum imager. Tune exposure 1-30 s.
steps.verificationMd: Bands visible at expected MW. No saturation. Strip + reprobe planning written down if applicable.
